name: text-companion
title: GPT Tools
description: Quick fixes, rewriting, translation and chat with your ChatGPT subscription through Codex.
author: tatsuki0123

commands.name: quick-fix
commands.title: Quick Fix
commands.subtitle: GPT Tools
commands.description: Fix only spelling and grammar in selected text

commands.name: rewrite
commands.title: Rewrite
commands.subtitle: GPT Tools
commands.description: Rewrite or translate selected text using your writing preferences

commands.name: ask-ai
commands.title: Ask AI
commands.subtitle: GPT Tools
commands.description: Chat, explain or summarize, with optional selected text

preferences.name: defaultModel
preferences.title: Model
preferences.description: Default for Quick Fix, Rewrite and Ask AI. Options come from the local Codex model catalog; account access is checked when you send a request.

preferences.name: customModel
preferences.title: Custom model ID (optional)
preferences.description: Overrides the model dropdown when filled. Leave blank to use the dropdown.

preferences.name: translationLanguage
preferences.title: Translate to
preferences.description: Default language used by the Translate action in Rewrite.

preferences.name: quickFixInstructions
preferences.title: Quick Fix instructions
preferences.description: Independent editing instructions used only by Quick Fix. Rewrite instructions do not apply to this command.
preferences.default: Fix spelling and grammar only. Keep my wording, tone, language and paragraph breaks.

preferences.name: writingStyle
preferences.title: Rewrite instructions
preferences.description: Your tone and wording preferences. Applies only to Rewrite, not Quick Fix or Ask AI. Clear this to disable personal style instructions.
preferences.default: Keep my natural, simple English. Be direct and human. Avoid corporate or overly polished phrasing, semicolons, and sentence dashes. Keep meaningful hyphens in names and links.

preferences.name: codexExecutable
preferences.title: Codex executable (optional)
preferences.description: Leave blank for automatic detection. For a custom installation, enter the full native codex.exe path.
